id.title: Id
id.description: Globally unique identifier/URL for this conformity attestation

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of what was assessed and attested

assessorLevel.title: Assessor Level
assessorLevel.description: Who performed the assessment: first-party, second-party, third-party, or unspecified

assessmentLevel.title: Assessment Level
assessmentLevel.description: Basis for assurance: authority-derived, scheme-derived, or unspecified

attestationType.title: Attestation Type
attestationType.description: Type of attestation, e.g. certification, declaration, audit, inspection, testing

id.title: Issued To Party Id Scheme Id
id.description: Registry scheme identifier for that registration

name.title: Issued To Party Id Scheme Name

id.title: Issued To Party Id
id.description: Unique identifier (DID or URI) of the organization this attestation was issued to

name.title: Issued To Party Name
name.description: Name of the organization this attestation was issued to

registeredId.title: Issued To Party Registered Id
registeredId.description: Official registration number of that organization

linkURL.title: Conformity Certificate Link URL
linkURL.description: Link to the issued conformity certificate document

mediaType.title: Conformity Certificate Media Type
mediaType.description: File format of the certificate, e.g. application/pdf

digestMultibase.title: Conformity Certificate Digest Multibase
digestMultibase.description: Cryptographic content hash used to verify the certificate hasn't been tampered with

id.title: Conformity Assessment Assessment Criteria Conformity Topic Id
id.description: Identifier of the subject-matter topic assessed against

name.title: Conformity Assessment Assessment Criteria Conformity Topic Name

definition.title: Conformity Assessment Assessment Criteria Conformity Topic Definition

id.description: Identifier of the standard/criteria document used

id.title: Conformity Assessment Assessed Performance Metric Id
id.description: Identifier of the metric being measured

name.title: Conformity Assessment Assessed Performance Metric Name

value.title: Conformity Assessment Assessed Performance Measure Value

unit.title: Conformity Assessment Assessed Performance Measure Unit

code.title: Conformity Assessment Assessed Performance Score Code

rank.title: Conformity Assessment Assessed Performance Score Rank
rank.description: Ordinal ranking of the score, if applicable

id.title: Conformity Assessment Id
id.description: Unique identifier of the underlying assessment

description.title: Conformity Assessment Description
description.description: Free-text description of the assessment performed

assessmentDate.title: Conformity Assessment Assessment Date
assessmentDate.description: Date the assessment was carried out
